questions.question: Present Indefinite Tense is used for which of the following?
options: Daily routine, habitual actions, and universal truths
questions.rationale: Present Indefinite Tense is used for Daily Routine, Habitual Actions, and Universal Truths.

questions.question: For a singular subject in Present Indefinite positive, what is added to the base verb?
questions.rationale: For singular subjects (He, She, It, Name), the structure is Subject + V1 + s/es + Object.

questions.question: Which adverbs do NOT take 'do not/does not' in negative contexts?
options: Hardly, barely, scarcely, often, seldom, always, never
questions.rationale: Adverbs like hardly, barely, scarcely, often, seldom, always, and never do not take do not/does not — e.g., 'I hardly listen to anyone.'

questions.question: Into how many sub-types is each tense category (Present, Past, Future) divided?
questions.rationale: Each tense category contains four sub-types: Indefinite, Continuous, Perfect, and Perfect Continuous.
